plain_text:
John Lund appears in 84 recordings across 8 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1946 to 1958. The credits here include performer.

In this archive, you will hear John Lund most often in Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar, Screen Directors Playhouse, Suspense, A Man Called X, Academy Award Theater, Escape, Lux Radio Theatre, and Screen Guild Theater.

Characters credited here include Johnny Dollar and Ken Thurston.
